skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% AT damage to a single target, and reduces damage taken by self% for 1 turn.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 75% AT damage to each enemy in the entire column, and grants self and allies in the same row [Tenacity] (absorbs damage equal to 20% of own HP).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 94% AT damage to each enemy in the entire column, and grants self and allies in the same row [Tenacity] (absorbs damage equal to 30% of own HP).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own H. Deals extra damage equal to 8% of own max HP to enemies.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own H. Deals extra damage equal to 9% of own max HP to enemies, and has a 50% chance to deal an equal amount of extra damage to enemies in the same row as the main target.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own H. Deals extra damage equal to 9.5% of own max HP to enemies, and has a 50% chance to deal an equal amount of extra damage to enemies in the same row as the main target.

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
